name: SpectraSphere
tagline: Turns shared memories and photos into story panels you can walk through in AR glasses.

awards: Snap: Spectacles AR Hackathon: Game On!

problem: Friends reconnect through retelling stories, but photos stay flat.
solution: Uploaded memories become living story panels in AR, with style filters, using cloud AI behind the glasses.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter story mode and see memories unfold around you.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Snap: Spectacles AR Hackathon: Game On!” among 261 submissions.
Built by old friends reconnecting at the event.

lessons: AR prizes favour experiences that feel personal.
